data.name: C3 Nightfall
data.detailed_description:
COLLECT. COMBINE. COMBAT.

Collect the relics. Combine their powers. Combat the monsters and gather enough cosmic crystals.

COLLECT

Search the castle grounds as mysterious relics rain down from the comet cloud.

COMBINE

Learn how different relics can be combined to create powerful magical weapon.

COMBAT

Put your creations to the test as the monsters arrive.

The Story

Twenty years ago, royal wizard Lazaar attempted to harness the power of a comet and open a portal to another world. The spell succeeded—but something went terribly wrong. A mysterious cloud formed above the castle, raining powerful relics and terrifying monsters upon the kingdom.

But the monsters carry something the King desperately needs. When they die, they release Cosmic Crystals—fragments of the energy that came through the portal. Collect enough, and you may finally have the power to close the portal for good.

Blamed for the catastrophe, Lazaar went rogue and vanished into the comet cloud. Now he commands the portal’s power, determined to drive everyone from his castle.

Fight through waves of undead soldiers, mummies, giant spiders, and trolls. And as the night deepens, prepare to face creatures far more terrifying—including dragons.

⚔️ Third-Person Fantasy Combat

Play the role of a powerful warrior and fight monsters in fast-paced third-person combat using swords, exploding orbs, enchanted staffs and devastating magical abilities.

💎 Collect Relics

Every night begins with relics falling from the mysterious comet cloud.

Explore the castle grounds, collect valuable relics and prepare yourself for the battle that follows.

🔥 Combine Relics to Forge Weapons

Relics aren't just collectibles.

Combine them to create powerful weapons and magical abilities. Discover different combinations and build an arsenal capable of dealing with increasingly dangerous creatures.

Forge weapons such as:

  • Fire-infused swords

  • Magical orbs

  • Wizard staffs

  • Elemental attacks

👹 Fight Monsters From Another World

The portal has brought creatures unlike anything the kingdom has ever seen.

Battle:

  • Undead soldiers

  • Mummies

  • Giant spiders

  • Trolls

  • Dragons

  • And more creatures to come

💠 Harvest Cosmic Crystals

Every monster carries a fragment of cosmic energy. Defeat them and collect their Cosmic Crystals. These mysterious crystals are the key to closing the portal permanently.

🧙 A Rogue Wizard

Lazaar, the former royal wizard, is no longer on your side. Somewhere within the comet cloud, he is using the very power that caused the catastrophe against the King and his kingdom. As you progress, you will uncover more about the portal and what truly happened twenty years ago.

👑 Serve the King

The King has given you one mission:

Reclaim the castle and put an end to the creatures that have taken it over.

The Hand of the King will guide you through your mission, while the Princess uses her knowledge of the monsters and the strange relics to help you understand the threat.

Upcoming Features

The game is actively being developed. Planned additions include:

  • 🐉 New monsters including giant spiders, trolls and dragons

  • ⚔️ More magical weapons and weapon combinations

  • 🌙 Additional nights with increasingly difficult challenges

  • 👑 Expanded interactions with the King, Princess and Hand of the King

  • 🏰 More areas of the castle to reclaim

  • 📖 Additional story and lore

  • And more surprises as development continues

data.short_description: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 550 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
